source_configuration_notes: Single means tendency mask in ACEs 2–8 with full 8-ACE geometry and PMB; pulse in ACE 1.
Multi uses all ACEs and default pulse in ACE 8.
Near-onset test alters only theta_e/qt at levels 11–30 of the pulse ACE; three prescribed qc bands 0.00049/0.0005/0.00051 kg/kg.
Original shared NC is unchanged; common manufactured state is exported once and imported into Fortran.
MATLAB uses actual local numerical routines, bypassing unused radiation/plume/plotting diagnostics; normpdf is absent despite a valid Statistics Toolbox license.
Fortran has test-only public access, existing mask flag and thermodynamic cache setter; active source remains unchanged.
limitations: No default 12-hour MATLAB or 48-hour Fortran run
No accepted equivalence tolerance or unified release pass
No original Intel build/Intel-GNU dynamics equivalence
Precipitation onset/timing and ice inversion need developer scientific review before changes
Four diagnostic snapshots do not characterize every phase transition between samples
